info.title: TutorLink API
info.description: Generated from registered Laravel API routes. First-party clients use Sanctum session cookies: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie before login or mutations, then send the session cookie and X-XSRF-TOKEN on state-changing requests. Conditional D23 endpoints are omitted until approved and implemented.
